posts.text:
DC Republicans are driving up costs and the reckless decisions need to end. Michigan families are paying the price.

Earlier this year, Michiganders were paying $2.70/gal for gas. As of today, that's up to $4.54/gal - a 68% increase and an extra $29 out of your pocket every tank.
